request.subject: UNIT:GUARD

layers.text: Change only the shield: replace it with a much bigger tall rectangular tower shield with a flat bottom standing on the ground, as wide as his body, reaching from under his chin to the ground, hiding his body and legs; crimson with a bold gold cross and a thick steel border. His head, face, helmet, one big steel pauldron and the upright spear stay fully visible beside and above it. Do not redraw anything else: keep proportions, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
